up: Retrieve exact activity values and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614240. Filter activities to only exact measurements (activities.standard_relation = '='). Return columns: activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units, compound_structures.canonical_smiles. Filter assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614240'. Join activities with assays on assay_id, and activities with compound_structures on molregno. Do not apply row limits or additional filters.
sql: SELECT a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614240' AND a.standard_relation = '='
